name: rotator
summary: The clock of a region that advances itself, and holds still while someone is reading.

data-interval.doc: Milliseconds each item shows; never below 200.

item.doc: One per item; the count is read every paint.

active.doc: The index of the item showing.

playing.doc: What was asked for: play or pause.

running.doc: What is happening: false while hovered, focused, hidden or under reduced motion. A play/pause control shows this.

go.doc: Shows an item and restarts its time.
